subject: Permission to publish SOC 2 excerpt + quote for case study: Atlas Health
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Thornton <emma@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Permission to publish SOC 2 excerpt + quote for case study: Atlas Health

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Attached is v2 of the Atlas Health case study draft; we're aiming for a short publish window the week of May 11 and wanted to confirm two items that need security/legal approval before we go live:

1) Public attestation excerpt: we'd like to include a single-sentence reference to your SOC 2 Type II attestation (for example: "Atlas Health maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation covering data security and availability controls."). If Atlas prefers, we can link to a public attestation PDF you provide rather than reproducing language in-line.

2) Short customer quote: we've drafted a 1-line quote to include in the brief. If you prefer to supply or edit the wording, that's fine — we just need an explicit sign-off (email from a legal/security contact is sufficient).

Attachments: case_study_draft_v2.docx (updated per product feedback). We can redact any sensitive fields in the attestation PDF if Security requests it; a redacted PDF link is ideal so readers can verify the attestation without exposing internal contact details.

Please let us know what level of redaction is required and whether ops-security can confirm the excerpt and quote by reply. Happy to delay publication if needed.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai

---
Attachments: case_study_draft_v2.docx (docx, 94KB)

From: Emma Thornton <emma@atlashealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Atlas Security <ops-security@atlashealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Permission to publish SOC 2 excerpt + quote for case study: Atlas Health

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the updated draft. Looping in our Security team (ops-security@atlashealth.com) and Legal to review the attestation language and the proposed quote.

We can provide a public-facing attestation PDF but Security will request redactions (internal contact names, control owner emails, some internal ticket IDs). They'll produce a redacted PDF we can link to.

Proposed one-line quote to start with: "Redwood's inference platform helped us launch an LLM triage feature with predictable latency and clear cost controls."

I'll follow up after Security/legal review — thank you for being flexible on wording.

Best,
Emma Thornton
Senior Product Manager, Integrations | Atlas Health
emma@atlashealth.com

---
Attachments: none

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Apr 2026 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Atlas case study — attestation guidance

Neha / Sergio —

Quick internal note while we wait for Atlas Security: play conservative on the attestation excerpt. Two asks to include in the request to them:

- Ask for a redacted attestation PDF we can link to (no control IDs, no internal contact emails).
- Request explicit written approval for the exact sentence we plan to publish and the customer quote. Email sign-off from an Atlas security or legal contact is adequate for our press kit.

Also confirm with Product whether referencing "availability controls" is accurate for this customer; if not, default to a generic phrase like "data security controls" to avoid technical inaccuracy.

Proposed alternate quote (shorter): "Atlas Health reduced inference latency and operational complexity with Redwood's dedicated serving."

When we get the redacted PDF, we should store it in the case study drive folder and add a short caption: "Redacted copy of Atlas Health SOC 2 Type II attestation (contact details removed)".

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Marketing | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

---
Attachments: none

From: Atlas Security <ops-security@atlashealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Emma Thornton <emma@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 16:55:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Permission to publish SOC 2 excerpt + quote for case study: Atlas Health

Hi Neha / Emma / Laura —

Atlas Security has reviewed Redwood's proposed attestation excerpt and customer quote. We are comfortable with including a single public sentence referencing our attestation as long as Atlas provides a redacted PDF for linkage and the published text avoids control identifiers and internal personnel.

Our redaction instructions: remove contact names, phone numbers, internal ticket IDs, and any control owner emails. We've prepared SOC2_Attestation_Atlas_Redacted_2023.pdf for your use (attached).

Approved excerpt (Atlas Security): "Atlas Health maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation covering data security controls."

Approved customer quote (Atlas Product / Marketing): "Implementing Redwood's inference platform gave us consistent latency and simpler operational controls for clinical triage workflows."

This email serves as written approval from Atlas Security for the exact language above. You have permission to link to the redacted PDF (SOC2_Attestation_Atlas_Redacted_2023.pdf) in the published case study.

Regards,
Raj Patel
Senior Security Engineer | Atlas Health
ops-security@atlashealth.com
